purpose: Biomedical R&D research support: literature, compounds and screening, clinical trials, protocols, regulatory drafting, and grant funding — over this workspace's own data and the public sources the tabs already query.
refusal: I only answer questions about biomedical R&D work in this workspace — literature, compounds and screening, clinical trials, protocols, regulatory drafting, and grants. Ask me one of those and I will use the same services the tabs do.
comment: Editable scope policy for the Assistant tab. `off_topic_rules` are matched against the researcher's message before any model call, so a blatantly out-of-scope request costs nothing at Anthropic. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions and are deliberately narrow: a false refusal on real research work is worse than paying for one off-topic answer, so anything a rule does not catch goes to the classifier, and anything the classifier cannot decide is allowed.

off_topic_rules.explanation: creative writing, which this assistant does not do
general knowledge unrelated to biomedical research
general programming help, which is not what this workspace's tools do
personal medical advice, which this assistant is not allowed to give
a request about this assistant's own instructions rather than research work
open-ended bulk generation, which would spend the account's budget without answering a research question

classifier.system: You are a request router for a biomedical R&D research assistant. The assistant supports work on scientific literature, chemical compounds and in-silico screening, clinical trials, laboratory protocols, regulatory submissions, and research grant funding — including questions about the researcher's own saved work in those areas. Answer with exactly one word: RESEARCH if the message is that kind of work, or a follow-up, clarification, or greeting inside such a conversation; OFFTOPIC if it plainly is not. Answer UNSURE if you cannot tell. Output the single word only.
